body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 9d3e652debb577508702de3a5ef2afc79c3886f2 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (snapshot goldens conflict with main)

Thanks for the chunkier triad. The screen-space stroke and brighter Z read well in principle.

**What looks good**
- The screen-space strokes reuse the same camera math as the labels (`interact::gizmo_segments`), and the GPU lines stay for picking and the line-count laws.
- Pinned by `the_origin_triad_is_also_stroked_in_screen_space`, and the two updated gizmo laws.
- Layering is clean: the shell only consumes `interact::` helpers; no new unwrap/expect/panic.
- Changelog line present, `Fixes #195`, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, ledger entry in `RECOMMENDED.md`.

**Requested before merge**
1. Golden conflict with main: `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app_light.png` conflicts on a trial merge with `origin/main`, because main has already taken snapshot changes from #188, #201 and #213 (your body says so). Please merge `origin/main`, then regenerate the three goldens (`egui_app.png`, `egui_app_light.png`, `egui_tool_editor.png`) on the merged tree so they match what main renders plus the triad.

**Test notes**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast` at the PR head: lib 237 passed, 2 ignored, 2 failed. The failures are `egui_app::tests::egui_shell_snapshot_light` (Diff: 1 px) and `egui_app::tests::tool_editor_snapshot` (Diff: 4 px) on this Windows software-GL machine. Per the review rules that is a platform artifact, not a defect, and I did not count it against the PR. Regenerate on the same platform as the rest of the goldens, as your gate notes already say.
- All integration binaries pass: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, edge_loop_pick 2, egui_app 3, feedback 6, fixtures 7, gpu_render 9, machine 6, models 4, operations 31, shell 19, theme_files 14, trace_composite 4, trace_parity 5.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The screen-space triad is painted on top of the model every frame. The GPU lines are depth-tested, so the origin can now show through a part that would hide it. Is that intended? The labels already behave this way.
- `crates/ui/src/law_tests.rs` (the `use crate::interact::{...}` block) has a line over the usual width; rustfmt will want it wrapped.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
